original_CPU.scope:
Unchanged original intrusive-list instructions, with no service substitution.

Valid bounded intrusive-list owners are private PE32 heap storage. Sorted-list
tag slots carry signed scalar keys; sentinel self tags carry pointer identity.
The original executable image is immutable in every case. Invalid/null owners
outside original entry guards are not assigned invented successful results.
scope_limits: Valid bounded circular owners and detached initialized items; invalid raw owner faults not assigned successful output.
Sorted scalar keys and sentinel identity are distinct logical slots; native packed-owner adapters still require review.
Current C nil/partial-link remove and append exceptions are compatibility behavior outside the original reference.

original_C_before.scope: Exact current C bodies in a bounded native-width fixture. Common already-native operations pass low/high controls; index traversal loses a pointer then faults, reverse owner and sorted insert casts fault at high addresses. These do not establish active or integrated game reachability. Legacy incompatible-pointer diagnostics are suppressed only to compile the unchanged before-code; this is not a product-warning reduction or port credit.

inactive_build_cache_cleanup.scope: Only inactive dedicated build cache cleaned. All selected historical and current programs,48 products, original C reproductions and compression pilots retain their paths and bytes. Modules, assets,Save, failures and CI ZIPs preserved.

caller_scope: Twelve public list entries now execute Go. Native next/previous links use full host pointer width; sentinel/scalar third-slot bits use uintptr outside Go pointer scanning. Signed32bit sort keys remain distinct from pointer identity and preserve the upper native-slot canary. Index and reverse traversal return native pointers. Public reverse ABI is explicit native pointer. Original service-free graph writes define full expected owners in three foreign placements. Existing nil/partial remove and before-insert compatibility behavior is tested separately; nil before-insert inputs abort through the same CRT. Actual native map-list C storage and payloads verify C/Go composition, while the existing Go initializer shares the same kernel. Private packed player-record/list owners4259C0+remain a separate required migration; no claim that those packed layouts are fixed.
cleanup_scope: Two includes/comment-only translation units had no global symbols/constructors and were retired with all exact bytes retained. No extra business-port credit.

inventory.scope: Same13split files, native macOS active AST. Semantic review hints; no reachability, bug, remaining-algorithm or completion denominator.

next_prepared_baseline.name_termination_contract_review: OPEN; StrCopy16 does not guarantee termination at capacity; do not infer a9unit production bound.

next_preparation_name_bound_correction.cause: V1notes inferred a9unit bound from the10unit Field2072 array without checking StrCopy16 termination behavior.
next_preparation_name_bound_correction.actual_source: StrCopy16 copies up to the complete destination length and adds NUL only when n<len(dst). A filled10unit array is not guaranteed terminated.
next_preparation_name_bound_correction.corrected_contract: No9unit production limit is proven. Review upstream input limits, ResetInd and adjacent Field2092 state before assigning a production bound. Original54sequences through11units remain unchanged and retained;11is coverage, not a proven API limit.
